recipes.title: April Selection — April Brewer
recipes.description: April Coffee Roasters' base filter recipe for their Selection, Espresso and Limited beans: 12 g to 200 g at 92 °C in two pours, each a circle then a centre.

steps.instruction: 40 g circle pour, then 60 g centre pour
40 g circle pour, then 60 g centre pour

recipes.notes: The recipe is April's stated starting point for the glass, plastic and ceramic April Brewer. April give the brew time as 2:20–3:00 and the target TDS as 1.25–1.35 — windows rather than points, so neither is recorded as a value. The grind setting is April's own EK43 dial, to be adjusted as needed. Before brewing, April recommend resting beans at least 14 days and using reverse-osmosis water at roughly 25–50 ppm.
